<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919961_theRebbe_975" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919961_theRebbe_975__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the name "Israel" specifically applies in the present era of struggle against the sitra achra, through the service of subjugation and transformation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">But still, one must understand,</t>
    <t s="2">what is the connection of "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you" specifically to one hundred blessings.</t>
    <t s="3">And this will be understood by prefacing what is said</t>
    <t s="4">(at the beginning of the verse)</t>
    <t s="5">"And now, Yisrael,"</t>
    <t s="6">specifically "and now,"</t>
    <t s="7">and the Tzemach Tzedek explains</t>
    <t s="8">that "and now" refers to the days of our years in this world,</t>
    <t s="9">and analogous to what is said at the conclusion of the previous portion,</t>
    <t s="10">"which I command you today to do them,"</t>
    <t s="11">and our sages said,</t>
    <t s="12">"Today to do them, and not tomorrow to do them."</t>
    <t s="13">For although the fulfillment of the mitzvos will also be in the days of Moshiach</t>
    <t s="14">(and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="15">then specifically it will be "as the commandment of Your will"),</t>
    <t s="16">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="17">the fulfillment of the mitzvos in the manner of "to do them,"</t>
    <t s="18">"doing" from the term meaning subjugation,</t>
    <t s="19">is specifically today,</t>
    <t s="20">for in the future it will be "and the spirit of impurity I will remove from the land,"</t>
    <t s="21">and consequently there will not be the service of subjugation.</t>
    <t s="22">And this is "And now, Yisrael,"</t>
    <t s="23">Yisrael is from the term "for you have striven with G-d,"</t>
    <t s="24">the domination over all the concealments and veils that derive from the name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="25">even to the concealments and veils of the animal soul and the evil inclination that entice a person to do the opposite, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="26">and the concept of Yisrael is that he dominates over the desires of the animal soul,</t>
    <t s="27">and even to "and you will prevail."</t>
    <t s="28">For at first they oppose and he dominates over them</t>
    <t s="29">(subjugation),</t>
    <t s="30">and afterwards "and you will prevail,"</t>
    <t s="31">meaning he vanquishes them</t>
    <t s="32">(transformation).</t>
    <t s="33">And this is "And now, Yisrael,"</t>
    <t s="34">that specifically now, when the existence of the sitra achra is present, he is called by the name Yisrael, from the term "for you have striven... and you will prevail,"</t>
    <t s="35">subjugation of the sitra achra and transformation of the sitra achra,</t>
    <t s="36">unlike in the future,</t>
    <t s="37">since "the spirit of impurity I will remove from the land,"</t>
    <t s="38">they will not be called by the name Yisrael</t>
    <t s="39">(striven)</t>
    <t s="40">but by the name Yeshurun,</t>
    <t s="41">or by the name</t>
    <t s="42">(other)</t>
    <t s="43">"which the mouth of Hashem will designate,"</t>
    <t s="44">as explained at length in the discourses of the Tzemach Tzedek.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the ability of every Jew to dominate and overcome obstacles now comes from the level of the Mah (Yechidah) within him, which G-d asks to be revealed through his own service.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it says "And now, Yisrael, what,"</t>
    <t s="1">that even now when the existence of the sitra achra is present,</t>
    <t s="2">and even in the time of exile and even in the footsteps of Moshiach</t>
    <t s="3">(the actual "now"),</t>
    <t s="4">it is within the power of every single Jew to dominate over all obstacles and hindrances and to vanquish them</t>
    <t s="5">("for you have striven... and you will prevail"),</t>
    <t s="6">it is from the aspect of the Mah within him,</t>
    <t s="7">the level of Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="8">For since the level of Yechidah has nothing opposing it,</t>
    <t s="9">therefore,</t>
    <t s="10">by arousing the Yechidah within him,</t>
    <t s="11">he has the power now to dominate over all opponents and vanquish them.</t>
    <t s="12">And this is what our sages said,</t>
    <t s="13">"Yisrael, even though he sinned, he is Yisrael"</t>
    <t s="14">[meaning not only Yaakov but also Yisrael,</t>
    <t s="15">the name of superiority],</t>
    <t s="16">for in every single Jew,</t>
    <t s="17">even when he has sinned,</t>
    <t s="18">the Yechidah is in perfection</t>
    <t s="19">[and as per the well-known ruling of the Rambam,</t>
    <t s="20">that every single Jew,</t>
    <t s="21">even when his inclination overpowers him to nullify a mitzvah</t>
    <t s="22">(even to the point that in order to fulfill the mitzvah he must be compelled by gentiles),</t>
    <t s="23">he wants to do all the mitzvos],</t>
    <t s="24">and therefore he is Yisrael,</t>
    <t s="25">meaning he has the power to be "for you have striven... and you will prevail."</t>
    <t s="26">And what they said,</t>
    <t s="27">"Who is a fool? One who loses what is given to him,"</t>
    <t s="28">and it is brought in Likkutei Torah</t>
    <t s="29">that it refers to the Mah in the soul</t>
    <t s="30">[for since</t>
    <t s="31">he is a fool,</t>
    <t s="32">he does not fight against the spirit of foolishness that enters him,</t>
    <t s="33">he loses, G-d forbid, the Mah within him],</t>
    <t s="34">the intention in this is,</t>
    <t s="35">that the Mah within him is in a state of great concealment.</t>
    <t s="36">And it is also understood from the language "Who is a fool? One who loses etc.,"</t>
    <t s="37">that it is analogous to a lost object,</t>
    <t s="38">that even after it is lost it is in perfection,</t>
    <t s="39">only that one must find it,</t>
    <t s="40">and by searching properly — he will surely find it.</t>
    <t s="41">And this is "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you,"</t>
    <t s="42">that Hashem your G-d asks and requests from you</t>
    <t s="43">(from every single Jew)</t>
    <t s="44">that the Mah within him be revealed.</t>
    <t s="45">That he should not, G-d forbid, lose the Mah that is given to him,</t>
    <t s="46">and even if he has lost it, G-d forbid — to search until he reveals the Mah through doing teshuvah.</t>
    <t s="47">And it emphasizes "from you,"</t>
    <t s="48">that the revelation of the Mah will be specifically through his own service.</t>
    <t s="49">For even when the arousal of teshuvah comes through the proclamations that are proclaimed from above,</t>
    <t s="50">or through various causes being brought about for this, as it is said,</t>
    <t s="51">"He devises plans so that the outcast shall not be cast away from Him,"</t>
    <t s="52">behold this is only the preparation for teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="53">but the teshuvah itself is done specifically through his own service,</t>
    <t s="54">"from you."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the ultimate perfection of G-d's dwelling in the lower worlds is achieved specifically through our present service of subjugating and transforming the sitra achra.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, that "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you" is specifically now</t>
    <t s="2">("today to do them"),</t>
    <t s="3">even though the perfection of the fulfillment of the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="4">("as the commandment of Your will")</t>
    <t s="5">will be specifically in the days of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="6">it is,</t>
    <t s="7">in order that there be the service of subjugation of the sitra achra and transformation of the sitra achra</t>
    <t s="8">(meaning Yisrael),</t>
    <t s="9">for specifically through this is completed the intention that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower worlds.</t>
    <t s="10">And even though the ultimate perfection will be specifically in the future</t>
    <t s="11">(as above),</t>
    <t s="12">behold the ultimate perfection of the future is that then there will be the revelation of the Essence of the Ein Sof in this physical world,</t>
    <t s="13">the lowest level beneath which there is no lower,</t>
    <t s="14">and this perfection is accomplished through our deeds and our service now,</t>
    <t s="15">specifically through the refinement and purification of the world as it is now.</t>
    <t s="16">And for this purpose the soul descended below,</t>
    <t s="17">that the primary intention in this is not for the sake of the ascent of the soul that is brought about by the descent,</t>
    <t s="18">but rather in order to refine and purify the body, the animal soul, and one's portion in the world,</t>
    <t s="19">for through this there will be the revelation in this physical world and the intention of a dwelling place in the lower worlds will be completed,</t>
    <t s="20">as all this is explained at length in Tanya.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
